templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Common Paper standard Mutual NDA Standard Terms (v1.0): mutual confidentiality obligations allowing each party to disclose confidential information for a defined purpose. Completed by signing a cover page that incorporates these terms.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in cover page that incorporates the Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference to form an executable MNDA, with fields for purpose, term, governing law, and the parties.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) Standard Terms for providing access to a hosted software/cloud service, covering access and use, support, customer content, security, warranties, indemnification, and liability.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement Standard Terms covering target uptime, downtime calculation, support response times, and service credits. Designed to pair with the Cloud Service Agreement.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement governing processing of personal data between the parties as controller, processor, and subprocessor, including international transfers and data subject rights.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for giving early-access customers use of a pre-release product in exchange for structured feedback under a design partner program.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement Standard Terms for delivering professional services under statements of work (SOWs), including change orders, acceptance, subcontractors, and IP ownership of deliverables.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for two companies collaborating on mutually defined obligations, with optional fees, revenue share, intellectual property, and marketing terms.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement addressing HIPAA obligations for the use, disclosure, and safeguarding of Protected Health Information (PHI) between a covered entity and its service provider.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement Standard Terms for licensing installed or on-premises software, covering the license grant, open source software, support, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for short-term, limited-scope product evaluations before entering a full commercial agreement, with an order form for scope, pilot period, and evaluation purpose.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum that supplements an existing agreement with terms for AI services, inputs and outputs, model training and improvement, and related intellectual property and privacy obligations.
